remarks: Welcome to Park 215, Stamford's modern luxury apartments featuring contemporary design, bright airy rooms & every imaginable amenity! Located on the brim of exciting downtown Stamford in a secure, well managed community, residents will enjoy a cool, open kitchen with granite & stainless, window-lined living spaces, gorgeous full bath with modern subway tile, skyline views, in-unit washer/dryer, on-site professional security, garage parking for 1 car, a well-equipped fitness center and awesome rooftop deck to take in the sunshine & outdoors. Adding to the features is a 5-star energy rating with hot water included in the rent and absolutely NO ADDITIONAL FEES!  Interested applicants must complete a Park 215 Application uploaded in supplements and credit check through Apply Connect only. Pets are welcome at Park 215, here are the limits: 1 dog 35lbs, 2 cats, or 1 dog and 1 cat OK. Park 215 is a no smoking community.
